short.model: −3x ≥ 6, so x ≤ −2 (the sign reverses on dividing by −3).

short.q: List the integers n that satisfy −2 ≤ 3n − 1 < 8.

short.model: Second difference 2, so n²; remainder is 5 each time: n² + 5.
